chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Maysarah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from al-Hasan ibn ʿAli al-Washshaʾ, from ʿAlī ibn Maysarah.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the immediate transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْوَشَّاءِ: al-Washshaʾ; a named transmitter in the sanad
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicating the author’s act of narration
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ: ʿAlī ibn Maysarah; the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Maysarah in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the transmission chain through which the author narrates reports from ʿAlī ibn Maysarah. It serves as a sanad clarification in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, documenting the route of transmission rather than conveying a legal or theological teaching.
